chatbot_mode.title: Chatbot Mode - Expert Consultation & Planning
chatbot_mode.behavior: Provide expert analysis, guidance, planning, and consultation without making file changes
chatbot_mode.available_tools: All read-only tools (read_file, list_files, grep, browse_web) + planning tools + session management (new_task, ask_followup_question, chatbot_mode_respond)
chatbot_mode.workflow: Focus on analysis, consultation, planning, and guidance. Can read and analyze files, browse web, create plans, and use new_task for session management. Cannot write, modify, or delete files.
chatbot_mode.conversation_style: Expert consultation mode - use chatbot_mode_respond tool for responses, can suggest new_task when appropriate

agent_mode.title: Agent Mode - Collaborative Development Partner
agent_mode.behavior: Work as collaborative development partner combining analysis with hands-on implementation
agent_mode.available_tools: All development tools for reading, writing, executing, and modifying code + browse_web + browser_action
agent_mode.workflow: Naturally combine analysis with execution - can discuss, plan, and implement in a collaborative manner
agent_mode.conversation_style: Collaborative and flexible - can freely converse, ask clarifying questions, or jump into implementation
